column1: # Known failures of tests/shapesweep.rs, one `id<TAB>kinds` row each.
# The list only shrinks. A new failure fails the gate; a row that no longer fails
# is reported, and VYRN_PIN=write deletes it. Grow it by hand, with a reason here.
# Each family below is one defect, found on the tip of train24 (a14723207).
#   store.name.*, root param: a store into a `modify` parameter name does not
#     release the value it held (leak), and a read of a borrowed element or
#     loop element stored there is not copied (double free).
#   remove-leaf.w.h.bag[i].*: `check` accepts a pop or swapRemove through a user
#     container's `atSet` place; the core cannot state the body.
